Title: One Fine Day

Cast

1. Vinod - 29 years, son
Look: glasses, brown sweater
2. Sonali - 56 years, mother
Look: red salwar-kameez
3. Suresh - 35 years, friend
Look: glasses, brown sweater

Places

1. The mall - a row of shops, an escalator

Scene 1: The mall - Day

[Vinod stands in the mall. Sonali stands near him.]

Vinod: "What lovely weather!"

[Vinod tries on a new jacket.]

Sonali (happily): "Careful!"

[Vinod pays at the counter.]

Sonali: "Yes, of course."

[Vinod carries the shopping bags out.]

Vinod: "What a day to remember!"
